articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla., April 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.35 per share payable May 28, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 14, 2026.
articles.title: Crown Holdings, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
